rows.proof: TOWN OF LUNENBURG, GENERAL FUND APPROPRIATIONS, `SUMMARY & CLASSIFICATION OF ACCOUNTS`, FISCAL YEAR 2018 -- the Town Accountant's schedule, pages 30 to 34 of the FY2018 annual town report: 81 department lines built from 167 printed line items, in five columns (APPROPRIATED FORWARD, TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE, TOTAL EXPENDED, TOTAL ENCUMBERED, BALANCE TO REVENUE) under a printed GRAND TOTAL of 40,112,337.95 / 40,112,337.95 / 38,877,536.42 / 527,104.02 / 707,697.51. ALL FIVE PAGES ARE PHOTOGRAPHS (one image each, 108-114 dpi, no text layer -- pdfplumber returns ONE word per page) and were rendered with render_pdf_page.swift at scale 5 and READ. No recognition was used and the OCR cache for these pages is not a starting point: the generic extract built from it sums EXPENDED to 92,748,860.44 against a printed 38,877,536.42. A `fwd` OR `srt` MARKER IS A LINE OF THE APPROPRIATED FORWARD COLUMN, NOT AN ANNOTATION -- the page's own legend reads `fwd - forward from FY 2017` and `srt - Salary Reserve Transfer`, and every department's printed line includes its forward lines. WHAT PROVES THE WHOLE TABLE, and it is six independent things: (1) each of the 81 departments foots its own line items in all four of the columns it prints them in -- 0 failures; (2) each of the 81 departments satisfies TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE - TOTAL EXPENDED - TOTAL ENCUMBERED = BALANCE TO REVENUE -- 0 failures; (3) the 81 department lines sum to the printed GRAND TOTAL in all FIVE columns, exactly; (4) the 167 LINE ITEMS sum to the printed GRAND TOTAL in four columns, exactly, which is an independent route to the same figures; (5) the 23 `fwd` lines sum to the printed footer `fwd - forward from FY 2017 $665,368.25` to the cent; and (6) the 2 `srt` lines sum to the printed footer `srt - Salary Reserve Transfer $18,004.80` to the cent. Nothing was adjusted to make any of these close and nothing is attested: the document foots itself everywhere it is checkable. TWO FILES, TWO GRAINS OF ONE TABLE, AND THEY MUST NEVER BE ADDED TOGETHER: `fy2018-p30-appropriations.csv` holds the 81 DEPARTMENT lines and `fy2018-p30-appropriations-detail.csv` holds the 167 LINE ITEMS beneath them. Each proves something the other cannot -- the department grain carries BALANCE TO REVENUE, which the page prints only on a department line, and the line grain is the only independent check on the figures that make those departments up. WHAT THE PAGE DOES NOT PRINT is recorded as blank rather than as zero: 44 department lines print no TOTAL ENCUMBERED at all, and `Town Clerk's Salary`, `Transfer to Stabilization Fund` and `Transfer to Capital Project Fund` print no BALANCE TO REVENUE. Reading an absent cell as 0.00 would make a row the town left blank look like a row the town footed. ONE EXPENDED FIGURE IS NEGATIVE and printed in red: `Unemployment Comp` at ($4,004.00), which is what makes its balance 14,004.00 against a 10,000.00 appropriation.
